mapper.select: SELECT c.conversation_id FROM conversation c JOIN gru_conversation_context g ON g.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND g.conversation_id=c.conversation_id WHERE c.owner_id=#{userId} AND c.project_id=#{projectId} AND c.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY c.created_at,c.conversation_id LIMIT 101
SELECT tenant_id,project_id,conversation_id,owner_id,document_id,status,revision,created_by,created_at,classification FROM conversation WHERE owner_id=#{userId} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId}

SELECT g.tenant_id,g.conversation_id,g.project_id,g.document_id,g.document_revision,g.scope_snapshot_id,g.scope_json,g.scope_manifest_sha256,g.dependency_access_set_id,g.canonical_request_json,g.request_body_sha256,g.operation_request_sha256,g.operation_id,g.receipt_json,g.schema_version,g.schema_manifest_sha256,g.created_by,g.created_at,g.classification FROM gru_conversation_context g JOIN conversation c ON c.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND c.conversation_id=g.conversation_id WHERE c.owner_id=#{userId} AND c.conversation_id=#{conversationId}

SELECT m.tenant_id,m.project_id,m.conversation_id,m.message_id,m.scope_snapshot_id,m.document_revision,m.selection,m.content_ref,m.content_sha256,m.dependency_access_set_id,m.operation_id,m.candidate_ids,m.sender_kind,m.schema_version,m.schema_manifest_sha256,m.created_by,m.created_at,m.classification,r.message_sequence,r.canonical_request_json,r.request_body_sha256,r.operation_request_sha256,r.receipt_json,r.intent,r.execution_state FROM conversation_message m JOIN gru_message_record r ON r.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND r.message_id=m.message_id AND r.project_id=m.project_id AND r.conversation_id=m.conversation_id AND r.schema_version=m.schema_version AND r.schema_manifest_sha256=m.schema_manifest_sha256 AND r.created_by=m.created_by AND r.created_at=m.created_at AND r.classification=m.classification JOIN conversation c ON c.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND c.conversation_id=m.conversation_id WHERE c.owner_id=#{userId} AND c.conversation_id=#{conversationId} ORDER BY r.message_sequence LIMIT 501

SELECT operation_id,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref,target_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM operation_record WHERE operation_name=#{operationName} AND subject_id=#{userId} AND idempotency_key=#{key}

SELECT operation_id,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref,target_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM operation_record WHERE operation_name=#{operationName} AND subject_id=#{creatorId} AND operation_id=#{operationId}

SELECT resource_ref FROM audit_event WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND subject_id=#{creatorId} AND created_by=#{creatorId} AND request_id=#{operationId} AND trace_id=#{operationId} AND action=#{action} AND result='SUCCESS' AND reason_code IS NULL AND schema_version='1.0.0' AND schema_manifest_sha256=#{manifest} AND classification=#{classification}
SELECT payload FROM outbox_event WHERE event_id=#{operationId} AND aggregate_id=#{targetId} AND aggregate_revision=1 AND event_type=#{action}
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation SET revision=#{nextRevision},updated_at=#{now} WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND owner_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND revision=#{expectedRevision}
mapper.select: SELECT content_sha256 FROM version_registry WHERE version_id=#{messageId} AND owner_project_id=#{projectId} AND entity_kind='CONVERSATION_MESSAGE'

SELECT CASE WHEN relation_kind='MESSAGE_CONTEXT' AND actor_id=#{creatorId} AND decision_ref IS NULL THEN upstream_version_id ELSE 'INVALID_LINEAGE' END FROM lineage_edge WHERE consumer_version_id=#{messageId} ORDER BY upstream_version_id

SELECT COUNT(m.message_id) AS message_count,COUNT(r.message_id) AS record_count FROM conversation c LEFT JOIN conversation_message m ON m.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND m.conversation_id=c.conversation_id AND m.project_id=c.project_id LEFT JOIN gru_message_record r ON r.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND r.message_id=m.message_id AND r.project_id=m.project_id AND r.conversation_id=m.conversation_id AND r.schema_version=m.schema_version AND r.schema_manifest_sha256=m.schema_manifest_sha256 AND r.created_by=m.created_by AND r.created_at=m.created_at AND r.classification=m.classification WHERE c.owner_id=#{userId} AND c.conversation_id=#{conversationId} GROUP BY c.conversation_id

SELECT tenant_id,project_id,conversation_id,owner_id,document_id,status,revision,created_by,created_at,classification FROM conversation WHERE owner_id=#{userId} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT operation_id,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref,target_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM operation_record WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND operation_name='GRU-RECORD-APPEND' AND idempotency_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
